{{Top|leg}}
The '''Trading Post''' was a vast "open-air" market located in a series of [[Hangar/Legends|bays]] on [[Starlyte Station]] that were previously used to dock [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]]. Tables, displays and booths filled the area, with [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] offering their wares and products for sale to the station's population. A large number of goods were available for sale at the Trading Post, including illegal and [[Black market/Legends|black market]] items.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
